title: COMPOSER deep learning sepsis model linked to 17% lower in-hospital sepsis mortality
summary: Across two UC San Diego Health emergency departments, 6,217 adult septic patients were studied before and after nurse-facing alerts driven by the COMPOSER model. Deployment was associated with a 1.9-point absolute (17% relative) drop in in-hospital sepsis mortality (95% CI 0.3-3.5%) and a 5-point rise in bundle compliance. The design is quasi-experimental, not randomized, and several authors co-founded a company that commercializes the tools.
organization: UC San Diego Health; University of California San Diego
